name: Alert triage deduper
problem: Cluster and dedupe security alerts, rank by novelty and risk, cut noise measurably.
limits: Synthetic security alerts only. Dedupe uses observable asset/family/time signatures and severity, never ground-truth labels or incident IDs. Reported recall is distinct labeled true-positive incident recall; raw positive-alert retention is separately recorded in bench.json so duplicate suppression is not mistaken for retaining every positive alert. A deliberately colliding pair of distinct incidents exposes a false merge; evidence/collisions.json retains the missed event. Novelty is inverse batch frequency, not a calibrated threat score. No production detection or threat-intelligence claims.
next: Tune time windows on independent labeled simulations and preserve candidate incident splits for reviewer feedback.
